brief:
A senior British minister said the UK will "no longer" stand by while children are killed in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. Foreign Secretary Louise Haigh indicated that new sanctions are aimed at "increasing pressure on the Israeli government."

The remarks mark a shift in Britain's public posture on the conflict, though details of the sanctions and their scope remain unclear from Haigh's initial statement.

title: UK minister vows to end stance on Gaza child deaths
